about.title: About
about.summary: James Guevara Gamboa is a Frontend & Full Stack Developer based in Heredia, Costa Rica, open to remote work (also hybrid or on-site). Since August 2024 he has worked as a freelance Full Stack Developer, delivering 10+ client projects in real estate, corporate and e-commerce with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and Strapi. He speaks Spanish (native) and English (B2).

faq.title: Recruiter FAQ
faq.intro: Quick answers about role, stack, availability and contact.

items.q: What is James Guevara Gamboa's role?
items.a: He is a Frontend & Full Stack Developer. Since August 2024 he works as a freelance Full Stack Developer building websites and web apps for real estate, corporate and e-commerce clients.

items.q: Which technologies does he work with?
items.a: Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js on the main stack, with Strapi as headless CMS, Tailwind CSS, REST and GraphQL APIs, plus Shopify and WordPress customization.

items.q: Is he available for remote work?
items.a: Yes. He is open to remote work and is also open to hybrid or on-site roles.

items.q: Where is he based and which time zone does he work in?
items.a: He lives in Heredia, Costa Rica, in the Central America time zone (UTC-6, no daylight saving time).

items.q: How can I contact him or get his CV?
items.a: Email jjguevarag@gmail.com, message him on LinkedIn or GitHub, or download his CV as a PDF from the top of this page.
